rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates with IBM FileNet Content Manager through the Content Services GraphQL API, providing comprehensive enterprise content management capabilities including document operations (create, update, delete, check-in/out), folder management and filing, metadata-driven search across repositories, class and property introspection, text extraction, and annotation handling. Features multiple authentication methods (basic auth, OAuth, ZenIAM), SSL/TLS configuration, metadata caching for performance optimization, and fuzzy matching algorithms for intelligent class discovery. Built with FastMCP using asyncio for concurrent operations, includes audit logging, connection pooling, and proper session management for enterprise-scale content repositories and automated filing workflows.
